critical_code_review_comments: Book detail page takes 7-8 seconds to load - may want to optimize API response time or add loading skeleton
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Modified /api/books/{book_id} endpoint to allow guests to view book details (removed tier_level check that was blocking guests)
